notes.title: Office Fight is Going Mobile! 📱
notes.content:
[h1]🚀 Office Fight is Going Mobile! 🚀[/h1]
We’ve been hard at work improving Office Fight and making huge improvements where possible. Our team is small, but we're incredibly excited to announce that [i][b]we're bringing an early version of Office Fight to mobile![/b][/i] 📱

We’re starting small by launching a playtesting build over on the [b][url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Fenix.OfficeFight]Google Play Store[/url][/b].

We've heard from so many of you about how perfect Office Fight would be as a mobile game, and we can't wait to bring this fun puzzle destruction simulator to life on handheld devices!

A huge thank you for all the support and love so far🙏. If you're interested in hanging out with other Office Fighters and our Dev Team, or just wanted to provide some valuable feedback, come and join our [url=https://discord.gg/MZHW8McbWq]Official Discord Server[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/a28e666fbfeb35faf275cbf432b4d573d0773413.gif[/img]

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[i]If you're reading this, thanks for sticking with us this far! We’re excited to keep sharing more updates about the development of Office Fight, diving into the fun (and sometimes chaotic) process of bringing our game to life. Stay tuned for more behind-the-scenes looks and sneak peeks into what’s coming next![/i]

[i]In the meantime, come join the Fenix Studios community on [url=https://discord.gg/MZHW8McbWq]Discord[/url]! You’ll find all the latest updates, discussions, and can hang out with our developers.[/i]

[i]P.S. If you want to support us, you can wishlist or grab your copy of Office Fight on Steam, and if you’ve already played, a positive review would mean the world to us. Thanks for helping us bring a bit of office chaos to life![/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747060/Office_Fight/

notes.title: Office Fight OUT NOW! + Our Two Weeks Notice Campaign
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/06fc6fae7176dad7dfe6f1d91979c45e96062fd9.png[/img]

[h2]🎉 Office Fight is Out Now! 🎉[/h2]

We’re thrilled to announce that we launched Office Fight last week! 🥂

But while we're excited about our game's release, we can't ignore the harsh reality that many of our fellow developers are still facing waves of layoffs. Too many amazing games never get the chance to see the light of day.

It's a tough time for the games industry, and we feel it deeply.

After our team was laid off, we decided to come together to create Fenix Studios and develop Office Fight as a bit of cathartic relief. ([i]Because, let’s be honest, who hasn’t fantasized about launching their monitor at the office Karen? And for the tenth time, this meeting could’ve been an emaillll..[/i])

We know Office Fight won't solve the bigger problems in the industry, but we hope it can bring a smile to someone’s face — even if it’s just from lobbing a virtual coffee cup across the office.

[h2]Our [i]Two Weeks Notice[/i] Campaign[/h2]
As part of our celebrations of release, we launched our [b][i]Two Weeks Notice Campaign[/i][/b]. If you've recently been made redundant, we’d love to offer you a free copy of Office Fight. Head over to [url=office-fight.com/twoweeksnotice]our website[/url] to claim your copy!

This campaign ends on Wednesday the 4th of September, so make sure you reach out before then!

P.S. 👀 Looking to add some personal flair to your Office Fight experience? You can customize your levels and characters… ([i]For legal reasons, we're not saying you can recreate your very frustrating boss, but we're also[/i] not [i]saying you[/i] can't [i]RKO them in-game[/i] 😉)

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Hey Pencil Pushers!

Just a quick update that we've updated the demo! The focus of this update is mostly around localisation and also minor bugs/clean up. Now even more people can play Office Fight around the world!

Fixed bugs include:
- Character asset clean up
- Enabled localisation for French, Portugese, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese, Russian.
- Minor UI fixes

Office Fight will be launching August 21st so prepare your slingshot skills and get ready to cause some sweet office destruction! Every wishlist goes a long way so hit that button and stay up to date with all our updates.

notes.title: RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCED!
notes.content:
[h2]Attention all cubicle combatants! [/h2]

We are stoked to announce that [b]Office Fight[/b] will be crashing into your computers on [b]August 21.[/b]

[previewyoutube=q2umtYwHpiY;full][/previewyoutube]

From exploding printers to deadly robovacs, you’ll have every office item in your arsenal as you smash your way through Mega Corp in this office destruction game full of physics-based puzzles and action-packed boss fights.

Can’t wait till August 21? Go try out our exciting [b]new demo[/b] live on Steam [b]NOW[/b]. Yup, that's right, thanks to all your feedback we have gone and overhauled the showcased levels so you get a better slice of the game, updated our tutorials to make gameplay and controls clearer, and added a fun new rune you unlock once you defeat the boss; pssst: this is the infamous Impact Rune that really showcases the destruction capabilities of Office Fight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/637f5eebba48a509e57985433804ed15bb162e21.gif[/img]

So, sharpen your staplers, flex those RSI-riddled fingers, and prepare for the most epic office brawl of your gaming career.

Work Sucks. Break Stuff!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/fbf3f9ccca9bc1b5a243e9edd24a7656c1f400e3.png[/img]

notes.title: New Demo Update! Release is approaching!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Payroll Punters!
[/h3]

[b]We've got some exciting updates to share![/b]
A shiny new update to the demo is about to hit containing all the awesome feedback we've been getting from everyone! This will contain updated tutorials, a change of levels, and a new rune for people to play with.

We've gone further and beyond to make sure you feel satisfied with your damage. Build that multiplier then unleash your rage to get that maximum score!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/9a159bffb4c3e01b210d1a51327ea9b06256e54f.png[/img]
A new rune is available for people to enjoy once you defeat Karon. This is the infamous Impact Rune that really showcases the destruction capabilities of Office Fight!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/637f5eebba48a509e57985433804ed15bb162e21.gif[/img]

We've mixed up the levels a bit to keep things fresh. While the current version portrays the variety of levels in the game, we felt that as we approach the release date, we wanted to keep some things a surprise.

Speaking of the release date, we'll be making a release date announcement very soon. So don't forget to follow our socials for the latest updates. If you have any feedback or suggestions, feel free to hit us up!

notes.title: We saw. We listened. We tweaked.
notes.content:
[h3]Hello fellow Office Fighters! 
[/h3]
Huge thank you to everyone who grabbed our demo during Steam Next Fest! If you haven't though, make sure to give it a go...

While getting our final game ready for launch we sat as a team and went over all the valuable feedback you gave us. Question is... what did we learn?

[b]Scoring and Multipliers[/b]
Seems our scoring needed a little more TLC and explanation as to how this works in the game. 

We agree! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/fa8c55b733b2ce3d044f6a4b9094b312e3019852.gif[/img]

To make these more clear and fun, we've tweaked our explanations about the scoring and how the multipliers work AND added some visual upgrades to the multipliers to provide more player feedback. 

[b]Destruction and physics
[/b]
Turns out the destruction wasn't quite destructive enough... 

A-GREED.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/2e71668fbca2ea4a2ee19a6e8f9bba0c3d450465.png[/img]

We've gone in and upgraded the destruction to be more realistic and more satisfying. How? We made the weight and velocity of an object contribute more to the physics. Desks now break more like desks and rocks fall apart like rocks. 

Continue to hit us up with your feedback! 

Love,

The Office Fight Team

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747060/Office_Fight/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/fbf3f9ccca9bc1b5a243e9edd24a7656c1f400e3.png[/img][/url]
